say:1:1041105001:0.text: Ugh... So hungry. Hammie, do you have anything to eat?
say:1:1041105001:0.source_cn: 唔……肚子饿了。漫漫，你那里有什么好吃的？

say:2:1041105002:0.text: You ask me? You finished everything on the way! I don't have a single pine cone left...
say:2:1041105002:0.source_cn: 还看我呢，口粮不都被你在路上吃光了？连颗松果都没留。

say:3:1041105003:0.text: What are you arguing about? Can't <style="stress"><player_name></style> conjure up some food with his magic?
say:3:1041105003:0.male: What are you arguing about? Can't <style="stress"><player_name></style> conjure up some food with his magic?
say:3:1041105003:0.female: What are you arguing about? Can't <style="stress"><player_name></style> conjure up some food with her magic?

say:4:1041105004:0.text: Mr. Valen, your understanding of magic continues to surprise me! Food created with magic has the same smell and taste as the object, but it doesn't fill the stomach!
say:4:1041105004:0.source_cn: 维伦先生，我要被你惊人的魔法常识缺乏震惊了。魔法变出来...
